ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary black pigmentation is concentrated at the lateral margins and along the trailing edge. High-contrast mottled transitions exist between the black perimeter and the white central field, with isolated dark focal spots distributed across the interior lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 70-degree interior angle and a depth of roughly 12% of the total visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous sequence of irregular, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the trailing edges of both lobes, isolated from the dark water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convergent S-curve sweep; concave orientation originating from the median notch transitioning to a broad convexity towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters are visible on the white ventral field of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible on the left lobe, cutting across the primary white pigmentation field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The far-left distal tip shows an irregular, textured cluster of high-contrast pixels indicating localized biological growth (e.g., barnacle colony) or minor physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive finger-like black pigmentation projections extend from the trailing edge margin into the white central field, particularly prominent on the left lobe.
